title: Simple Sleep Vote
description: Simple Sleep Vote is a simple server-side QOL mod for Minecraft 1.12.2 that allows you to skip nights using player votes, without everyone having to go to bed at the same time.
body:
Simple Sleep Vote solves a common multiplayer problem:
having to force all players to go to bed in order to skip the night.

 How it works:

If there is only one player online, the night is skipped instantly, just like in vanilla Minecraft.

If there are two or more players online:

one player goes to bed;

a clickable vote button appears in chat;

when 50% or more of the online players vote, the night is skipped.

 Features:

 Does not modify vanilla sleep mechanics

 No coremods or mixins

 Minimal and clean code for maximum modpack compatibility

 Server-side only (clients do not need the mod)

 Perfect for private and public servers

 Use cases:

Quality-of-Life improvement

Saves time on multiplayer servers

Ideal for legacy modpacks on Forge 1.12.2

No conflicts with popular sleep or gameplay mods
